_about: Hand-picked versions for demo.html: Charlotte's picks + Claude's picks, sorted into Charlotte's two types (Oct 7, 2026). Type A = picture-based (uses or edits the original picture/template). Type B = topic-based (keeps the sentence, brings a new picture). kept/added/lost/emotion are a DRAFT: check and edit, then run  python scripts/make_demo.py

origin.title: Earliest known post of the image
facts: Date decoded from the X post ID.
Daily Dot says the AI image "originates from" this post. Whether this account made it, or with which tool, is not confirmed.
Post text and image not collected (X has no free API). Check by hand.

origin.title: The caption is added
origin.text: Leaked photo of heaven is going viral on social media. No wonder Christians are so determined to get there! 😍
facts: Date decoded from the X post ID. 13 days after the earliest known post; 37 hours before the Bluesky entry post.
Text read from the screenshot in the Bluesky entry post.
Reach as reported (not checked): 6.9M+ views, 2.6K+ quotes (Daily Dot, Jan 16, 2025); 7.1M views, 3,000 likes (Know Your Meme, Jan 17, 2025).
No credit to the earlier poster; nothing says the image is AI-made.

acts.title: Arriving on Bluesky, more than once
acts.summary: The X post reached Bluesky several separate times, as typed-out text and as screenshots, starting Jan 13. The biggest entry post (step 3) came 10 hours after the first.

acts.title: Type A · Edits the original picture
acts.summary: Picture-based. People work on the original picture or its X-post frame: recolor it, zoom into it, re-upload it, or forge the frame around a new picture.

acts.title: Type A · Talks about the original picture
acts.summary: Picture-based. People keep looking at the original picture and argue about it: who took it, is it AI, what does it look like.

acts.title: Type B · Keeps the sentence, brings a new picture
acts.summary: Topic-based. The sentence "leaked photo of heaven is going viral" becomes a template, and the original picture drops out.

acts.title: Type B · Passed hand to hand
acts.summary: Quotes of quotes of quotes: each person keeps the template and swaps the picture again.

acts.title: Long tail
acts.summary: Over a year later the template is still being used.
